For an open-ended casing, the textbook buoyancy-force relation is typically written as:

\[
F_{\text{buoy}} = P_e \,(A_o - A_i)
\]

Using your values:

- \(P_e = 2400\ \text{psi}\)
- \(A_o = 18.0\ \text{in}^2\)
- \(A_i = 12.5\ \text{in}^2\)

\[
F_{\text{buoy}} = 2400 \times (18.0 - 12.5)
= 2400 \times 5.5
= 13200\ \text{lbf}
\]

### Answer
\[
\boxed{F_{\text{buoy}} = 13{,}200\ \text{lbf}}
\]
